system.source: Bad Eden Bulwark + Shadow Courier v1.0 (RFI-native rules)

description.value:
The door you came through is also the door you can leave through.

You may use your class's The Crossing ability to leave a location you should not be able to leave. This includes:

  • Prisons, oubliettes, sealed rooms

  • Dimensional traps and pocket planes

  • Banishment effects targeting you

  • Political or ritual exile bound to a specific place

You may bring up to your Initiation tier willing allies along (1 at T1, 2 at T2, 3 at T3, 4 at T4 — note this feature unlocks at T3, so you can always bring at least 3).

You arrive at a location you have personally visited before. The destination is a player choice from your previously-visited locations, with GM right of refusal for narrative impossibilities.

Limit: Reverse Crossing cannot be used to escape an active combat round (you must be out of initiative). It still consumes The Crossing's 1/scene use.

system.requirements: Route of the Black Stair, Shadow Courier Initiation 13
